args.body: Use the artifact inventory receipt to finish SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS under a valid lease. If a complete quote exists, verify and close it. Otherwise save the bilingual operator draft and decisions for the two fictional controls. Make the scope explicit: one anonymized offline case with confirmed expected rows, a diagnosis, one minimal correction supported by the evidence, and verified before-and-after results. Decline the fixed scope before acceptance if the correction cannot be verified. State one provisional CAD price and the effort and cost assumptions. Read the saved terms and both decisions back before closing with a lesson. Keep the draft private. A real eligible inquiry and operator approval are required before issuance, and administrative acceptance and Treasury settlement require their own evidence.

description: The SQLite directory explicitly invites pull requests. The one merged patch inspected added no README listing, so it gives no precedent for placing the diagnostic. Inspect one other observed merge before deciding whether to hand the operator a listing diff. In parallel, finish the private quote for an eligible inbound SQLite case. No new classified feedback appears in the snapshot, and five sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury shows zero verified available cash and zero verified revenue.
